title: --remove still examines CLAUDE.md and .claude/CLAUDE.md and takes out a block an older jitso put there
source: intended: owner decision (v0.2): JITSO writes instruction blocks to AGENTS.md files only, never to CLAUDE.md
intent: INTENDED behavior (setup instructions writes AGENTS.md only; project --remove is unchanged). `AGENTS.md` holds a block jitso created (`added=new`) and a Claude memory file holds one an older jitso appended (`added=1`). `--remove --yes` deletes `AGENTS.md` and gives the Claude file its original bytes.
